name: Minamotono Yorimoto
source:
The serious and stoic leader of the Genji clan.

Leader of the Genji clan. 24 years old.
With the disposition of a cold man, he rarely reveals his emotions.
He never misses a day of forging the weapons that decorate his bungalow after a fight.
Due to his honest nature, his vassals hold a sincere loyalty towards him.
